command:
date --iso-8601=seconds
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
uptime -s
systemctl show bussassistent.service cloudflared.service bussassistent-backup.service bussassistent-backup.timer -p Id -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p ExecMainExitTimestamp -p NRestarts
systemctl list-timers bussassistent-backup.timer --no-pager
systemctl show bussassistent-backup.timer -p LastTriggerUSec -p NextElapseUSecRealtime
ls -l --time-style=long-iso /var/backups/bussassistent/*.dump
journalctl -u bussassistent-backup.service --since '2026-11-02 00:00:00' --no-pager -o short-iso
